purpose: Independent JPL June replication. The raw June window is acquired only after the May candidate-selection record is written. At execution, run only the guard mode selected on May; do not alter its settings or selection rule after reading June.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture. The later disconnectTime is a hidden environment event and must never be a controller input.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from the primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy, not historical delivered energy.

commitment_uncertainty.deployment_rule: At each plug-in each guard uses only JPL April calibration scores and JPL physical unplug outcomes already observed at or before that control step.
commitment_uncertainty.selection_protocol: Use the single guard mode recorded by the May coverage-first selection. Candidate modes are listed only to permit reproducible command validation; no June comparison may replace the May selection.
commitment_uncertainty.scope: Replication evidence only. Do not tune on June; JPL December remains unacquired and reserved for a final temporal evaluation.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real JPL sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations.

solar_data.note: Fixed regional GHI proxy, not measured JPL rooftop PV.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Synthetic shared-import scarcity, not measured JPL feeder data.
